answer.reason: The verses give Jehoahaz a few distinct deeds and experiences beyond the summary: his evil reign, his prayer to the LORD, and the destruction of his army by Syria.

clauses.english: besought the LORD, and the LORD hearkened to him because of Syria's oppression of Israel
clauses.quote: Jehoahaz besought the LORD, and the LORD hearkened unto him

clauses.english: was left with only fifty horsemen, ten chariots and ten thousand footmen after Syria destroyed his army
clauses.quote: Neither did he leave of the people to Jehoahaz but fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen

doubts: 2KI 13:3 and 13:22 say Israel was oppressed by Hazael all his days, but this is not a separate clause; kept only the army's destruction.
Verses naming Jehoash/Joash son of Jehoahaz (2KI 13:10, 13:25, 14:1, 14:8, 14:17, 2CH 25:17, 23, 25) concern his son, not him, and were left out.
